home.no_provider: No provider configured. Add one in the Models page first.
home.no_default_model: Provider has no default model configured

orchestrate.no_default_model: Provider has no default model configured
orchestrate.request_expired: Request expired (timed out or already answered)

skills.zip_only: Only .zip skill packs are supported (must contain SKILL.md inside)

graph.cycle: Orchestration graph contains a cycle (cycles not supported)

registry.invalid_sources: At least one source must be kept
registry.invalid_source_id: Source ID is empty or duplicate
registry.invalid_source_template: Source template must use https:// and contain {path} placeholder
registry.pr_no_token: Auto PR requires a write-enabled GitHub Token in Settings → Registry (or use manual fork + PR)
registry.pr_missing_manifest: Missing file list or asset list
registry.pr_rate_limited: GitHub API rate limit exceeded, try again in an hour
registry.pr_forbidden: Token insufficient permissions (auto PR needs classic with repo scope, or fine-grained with Contents+Pull requests read/write on fork; see Settings guide)
registry.pr_unauthorized: Token invalid or revoked, please reconfigure in Settings
registry.pr_not_found: Repository unreachable or token lacks access (check repo config and token permissions)

tools.approval_unavailable: Tool approval not available in this environment
tools.approval_timeout: Tool approval timed out (300s no response)
tools.approval_aborted: Run cancelled or superseded by a new task, tool approval aborted
tools.shell_nonzero_exit: Shell command exited with non-zero code
tools.skill_not_found: Skill not found or has been removed
tools.skill_invalid_path: Script path must be a relative path inside scripts/
tools.reddit_blocked: Reddit blocked raw fetch, use opencli_run fallback
tools.poster_template_missing: Poster template missing (deleted — restore builtin templates in settings)
tools.poster_render_failed: Image render failed (Chrome headless screenshot error)

create.invalid_args: Create args failed validation (e.g. empty graph nodes or missing fields)
create.empty_payload: Persona update payload empty: provide instructions or a profile field

secrets.safe_storage_unavailable: System keychain unavailable, cannot encrypt/decrypt API key

kb.invalid_input: Knowledge base params failed validation (missing title/content or bad format)
kb.empty_content: Document content is empty, cannot ingest
kb.not_found: Document not found or has been deleted
kb.embed_unavailable: Embedding model not ready, fell back to lexical-only index (download the model in Settings)
kb.provider_not_ready: Embedding provider not ready (local model missing or remote provider incomplete), cannot reindex
kb.model_not_found: Embedding model file missing or download failed
kb.empty_extraction: Extraction produced no content, cannot ingest
kb.file_too_large: File too large (>{{mb}}MB), split it and retry
